## Change

Describe the visitor or integration need and the chosen technical approach.

## Verification

- [ ] Lint and TypeScript checks pass.
- [ ] Unit and integration tests cover the changed state or data contract.
- [ ] Desktop and mobile browser regression passes.
- [ ] Storybook documents new or changed component states.
- [ ] Accessibility semantics, keyboard behavior, and visible focus were reviewed.
- [ ] Input validation and failure states were reviewed.
- [ ] The explanation below is understandable without front-end implementation context.

## Non-technical summary

Explain what changes for a visitor or an integrating team, plus any remaining limitation.
